//==
// # Integer vectors
//
// Fixed-arity tuples of whole-number components: pixel offsets, grid steps, and
// voxel offsets. They implement IValue and IHashable rather than the IVector
// interface, so no norm, normalization, or component-wise division surface is
// implied — lift them into a Number tuple when real
// arithmetic is wanted.

// A pair of whole-number components: pixel offsets, grid steps.
type IntegerVector2
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    X: Integer;
    Y: Integer;
}
